a.lede: A Mississippi xAI data center is using eight converted jet engine turbines as a power source despite the known health risks of the carbon monoxide and volatile organic compounds they produce.
a.title: 8 converted jet engines are powering xAI data centers as companies look for new energy sources

b.lede: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.
b.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
